name: House
description: A 2 × 2 dwelling for five residents (Housing, stage 12). Three looks for poorer and richer districts.

variants.name: Half-timbered with thatch
variants.notes: Plaster and dark timber frame, straw roof, lantern by the door.

variants.name: Stone house with tile roof
variants.notes: Wealthier look: dressed stone, clay tiles, chimney.

variants.name: Plank cottage
variants.notes: Cheapest look: plank walls and wooden shingles.
